description: This file defines an abstract class StreamHandshakeToken and two derived sealed classes StartToken and DeliveryToken, used for stream handshake processes in Orleans. It includes serialization attributes, equality methods, and static factory methods.

classes.name: StreamHandshakeToken
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a handshake token with a StreamSequenceToken property and methods for creation and equality comparison.

classes.name: StartToken
classes.description: A sealed class representing the start of a stream handshake, derived from StreamHandshakeToken.

classes.name: DeliveryToken
classes.description: A sealed class representing a delivery handshake token, derived from StreamHandshakeToken.

methods.name: CreateStartToken
methods.description: Creates a StartToken instance if provided token is non-null.

methods.name: CreateDeliveyToken
methods.description: Creates a DeliveryToken instance if provided token is non-null.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on the contained token.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with another object.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides to provide a hash code based on class type and token.
